set.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- Sample and feature phases are profiled independently.
- Reusable workspaces remove evidenced repeated allocation.
- Warm-start telemetry proves use or safe fallback.
- Supported joint/independent modes have POT differentials.
- Representative-size crossover and non-regression thresholds are published.
set.title: Optimize UCOOT and across-spaces unbalanced transport
